content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have leaked extensive information about several upcoming Apple home products. These include a new-generation HomePod mini, a security camera, a new Siri Remote to pair with the new Apple TV 4K, and the much-anticipated HomePad product.

After an in-depth examination of the code, it also appears to offer important clues regarding the design direction of HomePad...

Filipe Espósito of Engadget discovered that although HomePad will very likely run some version of tvOS, its operation may more closely resemble an oversized Apple Watch.

The code also reveals a rather thoughtful privacy feature: HomePad will only display your personal information on Widgets when it detects that your iPhone is nearby.

We expect HomePad to come in two versions — one equipped with a HomePod-like speaker base, and another designed for wall-mounted installation.

Besides the other Apple home products I mentioned above, there are also references to other unknown devices. Personally, I'm really hoping one of them is a smart doorbell. Is there any Apple home product you're particularly looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
